main_body: A flat grass ground patch with a repeating tuft pattern, seamless terrain with no standing volume
top_band: none (flat terrain tile; the column shows only a mid-green #628433 with occasional dark or light tuft pixels)
evidence: The kind is terrain, so this is ground rather than a standing object. The column scan shows a uniform mid-green with only 1-2px tuft marks and no top band or front face to judge. It reads as a flat grass surface with no false 3/4 construction and no side faces, so it is acceptable as terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours, a median of 4 per tile and 19% flat-fill coverage. The grass reference has 80 colours, a median of 26 per tile and 0% flat fill. The candidate is one mid-green base with sparse dark and light tuft pixels repeated in an obvious grid every 16px, so it looks mechanically tiled. It has far fewer shading steps than the grass reference and is much thinner, flatter and less varied.
